name: Hydor
description: A star 4.2 solar radii and 3.04 solar masses, about 95 parsecs away, measured by Gaia.

text.card: A star about 95 parsecs away, 4.2 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.2 solar radii and 3.04 solar masses (FLAME) and 9,823 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 2 Ceti
quotes.card: 2 Ceti, also named Hydor, is a single star in the equatorial constellation of Cetus, near the border with Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It is visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 4.483.
